units.passage: The instructor may provide additional instructions or limits for any authorized activity. Permitted Actions You may use AI for general questions and support–including concept explanations, study questions, practice problems, ungraded exercises, and exploratory coding–on all work. You may use AI to help develop your submissions only for the specific assignments listed in Authorized Graded Work , subject to any instructions or limits stated for that activity. Prohibited Actions Do not use AI to produce work you submit on any graded assignment that is not listed under Authorized Graded Work . Do not use AI in ways that exceed the stated limits for an authorized graded activity. Do not submit AI-generated work, or lightly edited AI-generated work, as your own when the activity's instructions require work to be independently produced. If an assignment has stricter rules, those rules override this policy for that assignment. Examples Allowed: using AI to explain a concept, generate practice questions, or help you study for a quiz. Allowed: using AI on an ungraded practice exercise or exploratory code that will not be submitted for credit. Allowed: using AI to help produce your submission on a graded assignment if that activity is listed under Authorized Graded Work . Not allowed: using AI to fix a bug or rewrite a proof for you on an assignment that is not listed under Authorized Graded Work . Not allowed: copying work produced by an AI into your submission that is not listed under
units.why: 'Not allowed: using AI to fix a bug or rewrite a proof for you' on unlisted work bars AI debugging of graded work, P21.
